name: MonarchButton
title: Button
summary: The Monarch look for any SwiftUI Button (MonarchButtonStyle), and MonarchButton, a Button with a title, optional SF Symbols and a loading state.
whenToUse: The style on any Button, including buttons with a custom label, a role, or system buttons such as ShareLink. MonarchButton for a plain title, especially with a loading state.
whenNotToUse: Not for navigation bar or toolbar items; leave those to the system styles. Use one primary button per screen.
api: static func monarch(_ variant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, fullWidth: Bool = false) -> MonarchButtonStyle

MonarchButton.init(_ title: String, systemImage: String? = nil, trailingSystemImage: String? = nil, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, loadingLabel: String? = nil, fullWidth: Bool = false, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)
enum MonarchButtonVariant { case primary, secondary, ghost, danger, dangerSubtle, success, warning }

options.name: variant
options.description: primary, secondary, ghost or danger. Also dangerSubtle (a tinted destructive action), success (confirm, approve) and warning (an action that needs care).

options.name: size
options.description: xs (28), sm (32), md (36) or lg (40) points high.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only systemImage on a square button; the title is still the spoken name. At least 44 by 44 points.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a spinner and blocks the action.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when activated and not loading.

states.name: resting
states.description: The variant's fill, border and label colour.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A darker fill; not animated when Reduce Motion is on.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted fill and the disabled text colour, set with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner replaces the leading icon; the action does not run.

appearance: Primary uses the accent and danger the danger colour, in every theme. Secondary is a bordered surface and ghost has no fill until pressed. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The visible button is 28 to 40 points high and is centred in a 44-point touch target, so it takes at least 44 points of layout height. The web's brand, success, warning and danger-subtle variants are not offered. Disabled uses the disabled colour roles, not the web's 50% opacity.
accessibility: It stays a standard Button, so VoiceOver reads the button trait, the label and the disabled state.
The touch target is at least 44 by 44 points.
The label scales with Dynamic Type and wraps instead of truncating.
While loading, VoiceOver reads "Loading" (or loadingLabel) as the value and the button stays focusable.
The press transition is not animated when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: A long title wraps onto several lines and the button grows.
isLoading does not disable the button; the action is ignored instead, so the state can still be read.
The style is isolated to the main actor, like ButtonStyle itself.
